CF_HOST_SHIPPED control: `contact_factor_to_host` absent -> the host direction takes the shared realized draw (shipped (0.05, 0.3)); doubles as the drift witness vs the MEAL-SVC-01 canary row at 32b11ccf - report its confined-pax median beside 804 without requiring bit-identity across intervening merges.
CF_HOST_MID: host direction draws its own U(0.02, 0.08) per delivery on the dedicated host-factor spawn; steward side stays on the shared factor.

CF_HOST_LO (CANARY): host direction draws U(0.005, 0.02) per delivery. If the door-drop interval's low end lands the passenger mass near the bound, this is the arm that shows it; first submitted, read out alone.
CF_HOST_FLOOR: a declared scalar corner at 0.01 (no draw). If a scalar lands the bound exactly, the factor's floor is the answer - a source tranche, not more cells.

CF_HOST_OFF: scalar 0.0 - the responder-only corner reached through the host-direction seam rather than the direction arm. Host-credited tally must be 0 by construction (audit invariant); pax median should fall to the zone_narrow_svc_base level while deliveries stay up.
D0 x CF_HOST_SHIPPED corner: the full steward pool serving an unmodified lockdown at the shared factor - the complement of the OFF corner below.
D0 x CF_HOST_OFF corner: full pool, host direction silenced. The two D0 corners bound the host-channel contribution under the widest delivery envelope.

SECT sub-arm at CF_HOST_LO: structure x magnitude interaction at the bound-corner factor - section-bound stewards (~10-15 cabins, distinct-steward witness ~1-2 vs ~44 uniform) under the low host factor.

cells_note: 10 arms x 20 seeds. Seeded in-order per arm (20200205..20200224); each cell ~15 epochs/day over ~21 days with the voyage frozen.

admissibility.conditional_trajectory_clause: Seeds whose seeded case never completes takeoff produce no during-quarantine onset mass for reasons independent of the arm (their onset timelines cannot reach the window). On arms where the takeoff carve-out is binding - the two D0_declared/d0 rows - the during-window median is computed on seeds that completed takeoff (onboard_infections > 0) and the conditional share is reported alongside. takeoff_recorded_onsets remains an audit diagnostic (DP tally ~10), not a gate.
admissibility.passenger_during_bound: Passenger-class during-quarantine acquisitions by onboard takeoff: all-classes tally, confined-only tally, and onboard share of the confined tally are all reported side by side per arm. The scoring surface is the confined-pax tally (the channel the meal-service mechanism can reach) against the bound region (~52 from the frozen CW-02 design; record-implied pax mass ~45-160 stated as context, not threshold).
admissibility.during_band_reported_beside: During-quarantine total is reported beside the [150, 350] band - not gating (it mixes crew and pax); the pass/fail surfaces are confined-pax mass and crew share.
admissibility.crew_share_direction: Crew share of during-quarantine acquisitions is reported against the record 0.29 as a direction, not a threshold (MEAL-SVC-01 measured 0.379 at the full shared factor).
admissibility.crew_side_co_surface: Steward share of during-window crew acquisitions per arm (the host factor leaves the steward side on the shared draw - the co-surface verifies the co-traveller dose was untouched).

verdict_grammar.MAGNITUDE-LANDED: an arm lands confined-pax median in the bound region (~52) with crew share moving record-ward
verdict_grammar.OVER-ATTENUATED: armed pax collapses toward the responder-only floor (the svc_base level)
verdict_grammar.STILL-HIGH: confined-pax median above ~200 even at the lowest declared factor
verdict_grammar.NONLINEAR-BREAK: the response departs monotone in the declared factor - flag for attribution, not failure

audit_invariants: propensity_draw + presentation_draw_mode witnessed on every takeoff
droplet split (0.175, 0.0) echoes on every cell
crew_window block echoes service_direction on every DIR/base cell
host-factor echo: every cell echoes contact_factor_to_host + contact_factor_to_host_mode in crew_window AND delivery.caregiver.roles.service; missing/mismatched echo halts the readout
realized host-factor distribution: service_host_factor_draws median ~ declared arm mean (lottery check; OFF arm median == 0.0)

service host-credited dose tally > 0 exactly when the arm both declared direction both and a nonzero host factor; CF_HOST_OFF host-credited tally = 0 by construction (takeoff-conditional: a no-takeoff cell legitimately reads 0)
service_deliveries per cell within 15% of the MEAL-SVC-01 canary row median (~166k) - the door-drop cadence must not move with the factor
service responder mode echoed; stewards/host median ~44 uniform vs ~1-2 on the SECT sub-arm (max <= 6)
drift witness: the two *_svc_base rows are the carried-open CW-02 pairing under today's merged tree - deliveries parity is the binding comparison
report_immediately: canary lands confined pax near the bound with crew share <= ~0.5 moving record-ward (near-landing - stop, report before the array)
a scalar corner lands the bound exactly (the factor's floor is the answer - a source tranche, not more cells)
the response departs monotone in the factor (NONLINEAR-BREAK)
deliveries parity fails or the host-credit witness contradicts the declared factor

diagnostics: crew_window: deliveries, steward/host dose tallies, distinct stewards per confined host, host-factor echo + realized stats
during_quarantine_by_route: caregiver vs service_to_host route tallies per cell
